# Easy Grade Tool

> Free, ad-free grade calculators for students and teachers: quick grade chart, weighted grade, final exam score, test grade, curve, letter grade, GPA and CGPA. All calculations run in the browser; no account is needed and no scores are sent to a server.

## Grade tools
- [Easy Grade Calculator and quick grade chart](https://www.easygradetool.com/): percentage and letter grade for any test size, with a printable chart
- [Weighted grade calculator](https://www.easygradetool.com/grade-calculator/): course grade from weighted categories
- [Final exam grade calculator](https://www.easygradetool.com/final-exam-grade-calculator/): score needed on the final for a target grade
- [Test grade calculator](https://www.easygradetool.com/test-grade-calculator/): percent and letter from points earned
- [Grade curve calculator](https://www.easygradetool.com/grade-curve-calculator/): four curving methods
- [Letter grade calculator](https://www.easygradetool.com/letter-grade-calculator/): percent to letter and GPA points
- [Average grade calculator](https://www.easygradetool.com/average-grade-calculator/): mean, median and letter for a list of scores
- [How many questions can I miss?](https://www.easygradetool.com/how-many-questions-can-i-miss/): most wrong answers allowed for an A, B or C

## GPA tools
- [GPA calculator](https://www.easygradetool.com/gpa-calculator/): semester and cumulative GPA on the 4.0 scale
- [Weighted GPA calculator](https://www.easygradetool.com/weighted-gpa-calculator/): honors, AP and IB bonus points
- [CGPA to percentage calculator](https://www.easygradetool.com/cgpa-to-percentage-calculator/): 10.0, 5.0 and 4.0 scale conversions

## Everyday tools
- [Percentage calculator](https://www.easygradetool.com/percentage-calculator/)
- [Tip calculator](https://www.easygradetool.com/tip-calculator/)
- [Loan calculator](https://www.easygradetool.com/loan-calculator/)
- [Mortgage calculator](https://www.easygradetool.com/mortgage-calculator/)
- [Password generator](https://www.easygradetool.com/password-generator/)
